thread:
Marta (CS): Quick compact runbook for tomorrow's demo -> production handoff. Goal: avoid cold-starts, keep token spend predictable, and capture a signal for renewal risk. Need Eng + SE ack. Summary: prefix prefill, short cache TTL for onboarding teams, streaming enabled for interactive flows, and a one-question feedback pulse in-demo.

Jamal (Eng-SRE): Looks good. Couple operational knobs: cache_ttl = 900s (15m) for onboarding orgs; prefill 50 typical prefixes; max_batch_latency = 25ms for interactive endpoints; streaming_initial_chunk_tokens = 64 for snappy UX. Add fallback_model (quantized) when queue depth > 70%. Add an automatic cache rollback if error rate spikes above 2%.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare the customer-facing snippets and a tiny warmup script. Also add telemetry labels we'll require: token_count, avg_latency_ms, streaming_chunks, cache_hit_rate, and renewal_risk (boolean) settable by CS. Recommend customers run the warmup script in their staging account 2 hours before demo.

Marta (CS): Customer-facing mini-runbook (copy for docs/email):
- Preflight: confirm API key, billing, selected model & expected latency.
- Warmup: run the included warmup script with 50 synthetic requests reflecting demo prompts (include embeddings if used).
- Cache: enable prefix cache with TTL=900s and verify cache_hit_rate >= 60% after warmup.
- Streaming: enable streaming with initial chunk 64 tokens; verify client renders partial results.
- Batching: set max_batch_latency_ms = 25 and confirm p95 latency target.
- Fallbacks: configure fallback_model (quantized) for capacity pressure; verify fallback telemetry.s
- Feedback: single in-demo pulse: "Was this helpful? (yes/no)" + optional comment. Negative responses tag account renewal_risk=true and surface to CS.

Marta (CS): Example curl for customers (for docs):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood/open-14b","prompt":"<demo prompt>","stream":true,"cache_prefix":"org-{{ORG_ID}}/demo","batch_window_ms":20}'
```

Priya (Solutions Eng): Route config snippet for docs (YAML):
```
route_config:
  max_batch_latency_ms: 25
  cache_ttl_sec: 900   # 15 minutes for onboarding orgs
  streaming_initial_chunk_tokens: 64
  fallback_model: "redwood/open-14b-quant"
```

Jamal (Eng-SRE): Internal ops checklist for handoff:
- Run warmup job against customer's pinned model (script in repo).
- Verify KV cache sizing & cache_hit_rate.
- Start a canary streaming path (10% demo traffic).
- Monitor error_rate, token_cost, and latency for first 72h.
- If error_rate > 2% rollback streaming and open SRE ticket.

Marta (CS): Renewal signal workflow:
- Capture in-demo pulse and schedule a follow-up NPS at day 7.
- If in-demo pulse = "no" then set renewal_risk=true.
- Automatic triage: if renewal_risk && token_spike > 30% -> schedule SE deep-dive + enablement session.

Ethan (CSM): Owners: Marta -> customer enablement content & in-demo pulse copy; Priya -> SDK + warmup script; Jamal -> ops checklist + canary config. I'll create the kickoff calendar invite.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for route "demo-interactive" (canary=10%, image=redwood/open-14b@sha256:abc123).

Marta (CS): Plan to publish the mini-runbook to the onboarding docs and share with the customer 1 hour before kickoff. Small, actionable steps.

Jamal (Eng-SRE): I'll push canary config by EOD and ping here when done.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Adding SDK examples and warmup script to docs repo now; will link back.

Marta (CS): Thanks everyone — will close once customer confirms cache hits and in-demo pulse works.
